warnings: PNG contains two portrait sheets rotated 90 degrees within one landscape scan; programmatically cropped to left/right halves and rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise to read. This file is the physical RIGHT half (the lower-numbered sheet, แผ่นที่ 13/21), paired with แผ่นที่ 14/21 (3.1 detail start, LEFT half) extracted as _2.json.

Confirmed at 3x zoom: unlike category 2's rollup sheet (แผ่นที่ 4/21, where 2.1-2.8 are embedded bold text inside the รายการ column with a blank ลำดับที่), this sheet prints 3.1/3.2/3.3 as distinct, separately right-aligned entries in their own ลำดับที่ column cell, with the description starting fresh in the รายการ column. Both are transcribed exactly as printed, not normalized to match each other -- see the equivalent warning on หน้า79_2.

Unlike category 2 (whose sub-items carry unit 'รวม' with a blank quantity), this rollup sheet's 3.1/3.2/3.3 rows print quantity 1 alongside unit 'รวม' -- transcribed exactly as printed, a genuine formatting difference between the two rollup sheets in this same document.

This sheet's grand-total row 'รวมข้อ 3 งานระบบสุขาภิบาล' is printed here on the rollup sheet itself (all blank), matching the pattern already seen for category 4's rollup and differing from category 2, whose grand total also lives on its own rollup sheet -- consistent across categories 2, 3 and 4: the grand-category total always lives on the rollup sheet, never on the last detail sheet.
